d:
Pradhanmantri ke divali milan men patrakarita ke sare nashvar jiv jantu ek adad selphi ke lie aapas men kachodhan karte mile. kuchh shurvir aise bhi mile jinhonne un bans balliyon ko aadhunik taknikon ka istemal kar gayab kar diya, jo is milan ki rah men rora bani huee thi.
Vaise is desh men bans-dande ki bari mahima hai. kabhi yah virodh ki aavaz dabata hai, kabhi anushasan sikhata hai. ab yah pradhanmantri ko savalon se bachane ka kam karta hai. main bas itna hi kahunga ki bhaee tasvir se danda to hata diya, lekin tumhari halak men jo danda atka hai use kis eaaee se hataoge?
